title: transfinite-bounded-nuclear-square-shadow
description: The transfinite-bounded shadow of aperiodic-autopoiesis-cell: the commutative nuclear square (A, σ, Δ) structure survives at this regime, but fiberwise variation is bounded below ω_1. The Axiom of History Separation weakens: only countably many histories can be faithfully distinguished by the nuclear pair. Constructed from the aperiodic-autopoiesis-cell upstairs via regime-collapse.
